title: Reuse product component owners before installing registry blocks
problemCues: Building or fixing a screen inside an existing product with shared controls
preconditions: Consumer has installed owners or sibling surfaces for the same object
decision: Inventory shipped sibling surfaces and product exports first. Prefer installed product owners, then finished Shine blocks, then upstream controls. Never create a parallel control for the same object.
tradeoffs: May diverge from the catalog reference visually; preserves product conventions and upgrade paths
exceptions: Greenfield apps with no owners yet — establish contracts explicitly, then install finished packs
validatedBy: shine-reuse.json binds actual imports; completion requires reuse check
